guidance.CODE_NOW: Implement the closure on the default path, with a mutation-verified test and an in-lane skeptic.
guidance.DEFAULT_WIRING: Wire the paper-only default in the composition root, failing closed. A protected path gets a patch under docs/blueprint/lanes/.
guidance.PROTECTED: Write the change as a patch under docs/blueprint/lanes/ with its test. The parent applies it only if it adds a gate or corrects a comment and weakens nothing (decision 3 of 2026-10-25); otherwise it goes to the owner.
guidance.OWNER_DECISION: Read it against the 2026-10-25 decisions first. Billed infrastructure (decision 5), NCC (4), a hosted model vendor (6), new risk or capital budgets (7) and live capital (8) are declined for now: leave the row PARTIAL and name the decision in its gap. Where an accepted ADR already declines the requirement's text, the requirement text is authoritative (bar part 4), so the row stays PARTIAL and the gap names the ADR. Anything else is decided under the delegation with a new ADR in the lane's block, then implemented.
guidance.DEPENDS: Close the named rows first; do not promote a composite before its constituents.
guidance.DEPLOY: Leave PARTIAL; it closes only on a deployed environment, which is last (owner).
guidance.EXTERNAL: Leave PARTIAL and name the external party in the gap.
